potionRule.ExplosivePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to all enemies (base 10).
potionRule.Elixir: Choose any number of cards in your hand to Exhaust.
potionRule.AttackPotion: Choose one of three generated Attack cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.SkillPotion: Choose one of three generated Skill cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.PowerPotion: Choose one of three generated Power cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.ColorlessPotion: Choose one of three generated Colorless cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); the chosen card costs 0 this turn. This choice cannot be skipped.
potionRule.StrengthPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BloodPotion: Heal for potency percent of max HP (base 20%), rounded down when used; actual healing cannot exceed missing HP.
potionRule.HeartOfIron: Gain Metallicize equal to potency for this combat (base 6).
potionRule.DuplicationPotion: This turn, each of the next potency cards you play is played twice (base 1). Applies to any card type, not only Attacks; unused charges expire at turn end.
potionRule.BlessingOfTheForge: Upgrade all cards currently in your hand for this combat.
potionRule.FirePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to one enemy (base 20).
potionRule.PoisonPotion: Apply Poison equal to potency to one enemy (base 6). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.WeakenPotion: Apply Weak equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.FearPotion: Apply Vulnerable equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.EnergyPotion: Gain Energy equal to potency this turn (base 2).
potionRule.DexterityPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.SpeedPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Dexterity Down debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.SteroidPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Lose Strength debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.FocusPotion: Gain Focus equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BottledMiracle: Add Miracles equal to potency to your hand (base 2). A Miracle costs 0, gives 1 Energy and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.AncientPotion: Gain Artifact equal to potency (base 1). Each charge blocks one incoming debuff, including a temporary buff's removal debuff if it is applied afterward.
potionRule.RegenPotion: Gain Regeneration equal to potency (base 5). At each player turn end, heal for the current stacks, then lose 1 stack; healing restrictions and the HP cap apply.
potionRule.EssenceOfSteel: Gain Plated Armor equal to potency (base 4). It grants that much Block at player turn end and loses 1 stack when an enemy Attack causes unblocked HP loss.
potionRule.LiquidBronze: Gain Thorns equal to potency for this combat (base 3). It damages an attacker for that amount whenever you are attacked, even if the hit is blocked.
potionRule.DistilledChaosPotion: Play the next potency cards from the top of your draw pile without paying their energy costs (base 3). Enemy targets are random; normal card effects and play restrictions still apply.
potionRule.CunningPotion: Add upgraded Shivs equal to potency to your hand (base 3). Each Shiv+ costs 0, deals 6 base damage and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.PotionOfCapacity: Gain Orb slots equal to potency (base 2).
potionRule.LiquidMemories: Choose potency cards from your discard pile to return to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. If fewer cards are available, return the available cards; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.GamblersBrew: Choose any number of cards from your hand to discard, then draw that many cards. You may choose none; draw prevention and hand capacity still apply.
potionRule.StancePotion: Choose to enter Wrath or Calm. Wrath doubles Attack damage dealt and received; leaving Calm grants Energy under the current stance rules.
potionRule.FairyPotion: Passive: when lethal HP loss occurs, consume this potion and heal for 30% of Max HP (60% with Sacred Bark), rounded down with a minimum request of 1 HP. Cannot be used manually. Mark of the Bloom prevents this revival.
potionRule.SmokeBomb: Escape the current non-boss combat instead of winning it; no combat rewards are earned. Cannot be used against bosses or while the Spire Shield and Spire Spear surround you.
potionRule.FruitJuice: Gain Max HP equal to potency and request the same amount of healing (base 5). May be used outside combat; healing restrictions still apply.
potionRule.EntropicBrew: Consume this potion, then generate random potions to fill empty slots, including its freed slot. Potions already held remain. Sozu prevents obtaining the generated potions.
potionRule.SneckoOil: Draw cards equal to potency (base 5), then randomize eligible costs of all cards in your hand to 0-3. X-cost and negative unplayable costs are excluded.
potionRule.GhostInAJar: Gain Intangible equal to potency (base 1), reducing incoming damage and HP loss to 1 per instance while active.
potionRule.CultistPotion: Gain Ritual equal to potency (base 1). Gain that much Strength at the end of each player turn, including the turn it is used; it does not grant Strength immediately on use.
potionRule.Ambrosia: Enter Divinity this turn: gain 3 Energy and triple Attack damage. Return to Neutral at the start of the next turn.
potionRule.EssenceOfDarkness: Channel potency Dark orbs for each current Orb slot (base 1 per slot). Normal channel and evoke rules apply.

relicState.openingEnergySpent: opening Energy bonus spent this combat
relicState.openingEnergyChecked: opening Energy check completed this combat
relicState.discardEnergySpent: discard Energy trigger spent this turn

effect.randomDamage_one: Deal {{damage}} damage {{count}} time, choosing a random enemy for each hit.
effect.randomDamage_other: Deal {{damage}} damage {{count}} times, choosing a random enemy for each hit.

Buffer.amountUnit: remaining damage or HP-loss events to prevent
Buffer.effect: Prevent the next positive damage or HP-loss event, then consume one charge. Fully blocked damage does not consume Buffer. Unblocked Beat of Death can consume it; each hit of a multi-hit attack is a separate event. Direct HP loss also consumes a charge, even though Block cannot absorb that HP loss.
Buffer.timing: After Block for blockable damage, before positive HP loss; persists until its charges are consumed or it is removed.

Barricade.amountUnit: presence; numeric amount is not a stack count
Barricade.effect: Keeps the owner's remaining Block at the normal turn-start clearing point. Incoming damage still spends Block; the effect creates no Block itself.
Barricade.timing: Owner turn start; persists for combat until removed.

Berserk.effect: Gain amount additional Energy at each player turn start. The card's self-Vulnerable is a separate debuff with its own duration.
Berserk.timing: Player turn start, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

Energized.amountUnit: additional Energy at the next player recharge
Energized.effect: Gain amount additional Energy at the next player energy recharge, then remove this power. Repeated applications of the same color add together; green and blue Energized remain separate powers and both trigger.
Energized.timing: Next player energy recharge, before ordinary start-of-turn draws; does not grant Energy when applied.

Brutality.amountUnit: additional cards drawn and HP lost per turn
Brutality.effect: After the normal draw, draw amount additional cards, then lose amount HP. Draw prevention and hand capacity apply to the draw; Block does not prevent the HP loss.
Brutality.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

DemonForm.effect: Gain amount Strength after each normal start-of-turn draw. Existing Strength remains, so gains accumulate across turns.
DemonForm.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

DoubleTap.effect: Each next Attack card is played a second time for free against the same target, after its original effects. Consume one charge per original Attack card; Skills and Powers keep the charges.
DoubleTap.timing: On card play; unused charges expire at player turn end.

Evolve.amountUnit: additional cards drawn per Status drawn
Evolve.effect: Drawing a Status requests amount additional draws. Curses do not trigger it. Draw prevention and hand capacity apply, and newly drawn Statuses can trigger further draws.
Evolve.timing: On Status draw while active; persists for combat.

FireBreathing.amountUnit: damage to each enemy per Status or Curse drawn
FireBreathing.effect: When a Status or Curse is drawn, deal amount THORNS damage to all enemies. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify this damage; enemy Block and damage caps apply.
FireBreathing.timing: On Status or Curse draw while active; persists for combat.

Juggernaut.amountUnit: damage per positive Block gain event
Juggernaut.effect: Whenever the player gains positive Block, deal amount THORNS damage to a random living enemy. Separate Block gains can trigger separately. This deals damage rather than granting more Block.
Juggernaut.timing: On positive Block gain while active; persists for combat.

Rupture.amountUnit: Strength gained per qualifying self-inflicted HP-loss event
Rupture.effect: Gain amount Strength when HP is actually lost from a qualifying self-inflicted card effect, such as {{entity_card_Offering}} or {{entity_card_Brutality}}. Fully prevented HP loss supplies no gain.
Rupture.timing: On qualifying self-inflicted HP loss while active; persists for combat.

MagnetismPower.amountUnit: random Colorless cards generated per player turn
MagnetismPower.effect: Add amount random temporary Colorless cards to Hand at each turn start. They keep their ordinary costs; hand capacity applies.
MagnetismPower.timing: Player turn start from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

MayhemPower.amountUnit: top draw-pile cards automatically played per player turn
MayhemPower.effect: After normal turn draw, automatically play amount cards from the top of the remaining draw pile for free, choosing a random enemy when a target is required. Each played card keeps its own Exhaust rule.
MayhemPower.timing: Player turn start after normal draw, from the next turn after deployment; persists for combat.

PanachePower.amountUnit: cards still to play before the next damage trigger this turn
PanachePower.effect: Every fifth card played this turn deals the stored THORNS damage to all enemies, then resets the counter to 5. The card supplies 10 damage (14 if upgraded); repeated deployment adds stored damage.
PanachePower.timing: On card play; the counter resets to 5 at player turn start, and the damage effect persists for combat.

SadisticPower.effect: When the owner applies a debuff to another entity without Artifact, deal amount THORNS damage to that target. Artifact-blocked applications supply no damage.
SadisticPower.timing: On debuff application while active; persists for combat.

Poison.amountUnit: HP lost at the next owner turn start
Poison.effect: At the owner's turn start, lose HP equal to amount, then reduce Poison by 1. Block does not prevent this loss. Artifact can block a new Poison application.
Poison.timing: Owner turn start; decreases per trigger until removed.

Focus.amountUnit: modifier to Lightning, Frost and Dark Orb amounts
Focus.effect: Adds amount to affected Orb damage or Block values, with a minimum of 0. Affects Lightning damage, Frost Block and Dark passive charge gain; Plasma Energy and the Dark Orb's already stored charge are unchanged.
Focus.timing: When affected Orb values are evaluated; persists until changed or removed.

Regeneration.amountUnit: HP healed at the next owner turn end
Regeneration.effect: Heal amount HP up to Max HP and subject to healing modifiers, then reduce the amount by 1. With 5 stacks and no modifiers, successive healing requests are 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1.
Regeneration.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn applied; decreases per trigger until removed.

DuplicationPower.effect: Each next original card is played a second time for free against the same target after its first effects, consuming one charge. Works on Attacks, Skills and Powers. Replays themselves consume no additional charge.
DuplicationPower.timing: On card play; one unused charge is lost at each round end.

Vigor.amountUnit: bonus damage per hit of the next Attack card
Vigor.effect: Adds amount to every normal damage hit and target of the next Attack card, before damage modifiers. Multiple hits consume one Vigor effect, not one stack per hit.
Vigor.timing: Consumed when an Attack card is played. Skills and Powers do not consume it.

TheBombPower.amountUnit: remaining owner turn-end ticks until the explosion
TheBombPower.effect: Decrements by 1 at each owner's turn end. At amount 1, removes this countdown and deals its stored damage to all enemies as THORNS damage. The Bomb stores 40 damage, or 50 when upgraded; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. Enemy Block and damage caps still apply.
TheBombPower.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn it was applied. Starts at 3, so the explosion occurs on the third turn end.

Regen.amountUnit: HP healed at each owner's turn end
Regen.effect: Heal the owner by amount at its turn end, up to Max HP. Does not decrement. {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}} retains it after Rebirth. This is the monster's Regenerate, distinct from the player's decreasing Regeneration effect.
Regen.timing: Owner turn end; persists until removed.

Artifact.effect: Blocks one debuff application per charge, regardless of its stack amount, then consumes one charge. Damage and adding Status cards are not debuff applications. Separate debuffs from one card are checked in execution order.
Artifact.timing: At the debuff application, not at the end of the turn. The Artifact power is removed when its last charge is consumed; ordinary debuff duration reduction does not consume charges.

Anger.effect: When the player plays a Skill, the owner gains amount Strength. {{entity_enemy_GremlinNob}} uses this power for Enrage; Attacks and Powers do not trigger it.
Anger.timing: Triggers while this power is present; its amount is not a duration.

Angry.amountUnit: Strength gained per qualifying damage hit
Angry.effect: Gains amount Strength on positive sourced damage, excluding HP-loss and thorns damage. This is different from {{entity_enemy_GremlinNob}}'s Skill-triggered Anger.
Angry.timing: Each qualifying damage hit can trigger it; zero damage does not.

BeatOfDeath.amountUnit: damage to the player per counted card
BeatOfDeath.effect: Every counted card deals this much THORNS damage to the player. Block can absorb it; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. {{entity_relic_Torii}}'s normal-hit reduction does not apply to this THORNS damage. It resolves after the card's own effects but before that card's final exhaust triggers {{entity_card_FeelNoPain}}. Extra actions a card queues can have their own exhaust triggers; inspect the settled result for timing-sensitive sequences.
BeatOfDeath.timing: After-use trigger, not the start of card play; persists until removed.

Confusion.effect: Whenever a card with a nonnegative combat cost is drawn, randomize that instance's combat cost to 0, 1, 2 or 3. X-cost and unplayable cards are excluded. This can make cheap cards more expensive or expensive cards cheaper. Each new draw can randomize the cost again; use the displayed hand cost.
Confusion.timing: Persists for the rest of combat; the amount is not a duration or a multiplier.

Constricted.amountUnit: Thorns damage dealt to the owner each turn end
Constricted.effect: At the owner's turn end, the original creature source deals amount Thorns damage to the owner. Block can absorb it; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not change it. Repeated applications add amount while keeping the first source. Artifact can block application and debuff removal can remove it.
Constricted.timing: Owner turn end, including the turn of application. Persists until removed; does not decrement each round.

Curiosity.amountUnit: permanent Strength gained per player Power card
Curiosity.effect: Whenever the player plays a Power card, grant the owner this much Strength. Attacks and Skills do not trigger it. {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}} removes Curiosity at first-phase lethal damage.
Curiosity.timing: Card-play trigger; persists until removed, not a turn countdown.

CurlUp.effect: On the first qualifying damage hit, gains amount Block after damage and removes Curl Up. Requires positive damage, a living owner and a damage source.
CurlUp.timing: Triggers once, not on every hit. A lethal hit does not gain Block.

Dexterity.effect: Adds amount to Block gained from cards before other Block modifiers. Does not add Block by itself.
Dexterity.timing: Persists until another effect changes or removes it.

DexterityDown.amountUnit: Dexterity to subtract at owner's turn end
DexterityDown.effect: Subtract the stored amount from the owner's then-current Dexterity, then remove this power. Already gained Block stays. This is a fixed subtraction, not a reset; Artifact can block application of this debuff.
DexterityDown.timing: Owner's turn end, once; {{entity_potion_SpeedPotion}}'s temporary Dexterity expires this way.

DrawReduction.amountUnit: cards subtracted from the normal start-of-turn draw
DrawReduction.effect: Reduce the owner's normal turn-start draw by amount. Does not reduce card-effect draws such as {{entity_card_PommelStrike}} or {{entity_card_ShrugItOff}}.
DrawReduction.timing: At end of round, reduce amount by 1; skip the first decrement while newly applied, so the next normal draw is reduced.

Entangle.effect: Prevents playing Attack cards while active. Skills and Powers remain playable.
Entangle.timing: Removed at the end of the affected player's turn.

Explosive.effect: At 1, kill the owner and then deal 30 Thorns damage to the player. Player Block absorbs this damage; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify it. At higher amounts, decrease by 1. Killing the owner earlier prevents its countdown from running.
Explosive.timing: Runs during the owner's turn, queued after its move actions and before the next monster's move actions, not at end of round.

Fading.effect: After the owner's queued move, decrease by 1; at 1 or less, kill the owner instead. Its current attack still executes before disappearance. You can win by surviving until this countdown completes.
Fading.timing: Runs during the owner's turn after its move actions, before the next monster's move actions. Does not tick at end of round.

Flight.effect: While present, halves normal damage before Block, rounded down. Each normal hit that causes positive HP loss to a surviving owner and has a source removes 1 Flight; multiple hits from one card count separately. Fully blocked hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not remove Flight; Thorns and HP-loss effects also bypass its damage reduction. At zero Flight, a {{entity_enemy_Byrd}} loses flying status and immediately replaces its current intent with Stunned.
Flight.timing: At the owner's turn start, remaining Flight restores to its stored initial amount if it was not completely removed. Grounded {{entity_enemy_Byrd}}s regain Flight only when executing Go Airborne.

Frail.effect: Reduces Block gained from cards by 25%, rounded down. More stacks extend duration, not the reduction.
Frail.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick.

GenericStrengthUp.effect: At the end of each round, gain Strength equal to amount if amount is positive. The effect itself persists and does not decrement. It does not grant Strength immediately when applied.
GenericStrengthUp.timing: End-of-round power hook, after the monsters have executed their moves; the gained Strength affects later attacks.

Hex.amountUnit: Dazed cards added per non-Attack card played
Hex.effect: When the owner plays a non-Attack card, including a Skill or Power, add amount unupgraded Dazed to random positions in the owner's draw pile. Dazed is unplayable and Ethereal. Attacks do not trigger this effect.
Hex.timing: Card play; persists until removed. Does not decrement each round. Artifact can block its application and debuff removal can remove it.

Intangible.amountUnit: remaining owner turns of monster Intangible
Intangible.effect: While positive, cap each final damage or direct HP-loss instance above 1 to 1. Multi-hit attacks still apply a separate capped instance for each hit. This is the monster version; the player's version has stable ID IntangiblePlayer.
Intangible.timing: Decreases by 1 at the owner's turn end, unless just applied skips that tick.

IntangiblePlayer.effect: While positive, cap each final damage or direct HP-loss instance above 1 to 1. Multi-hit attacks still apply a separate capped instance for each hit. Normal damage can then be absorbed by Block; Intangible itself does not create Block.
IntangiblePlayer.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, after the enemy turn. One stack gained during your turn protects through that enemy turn; additional stacks extend duration.

Invincible.amountUnit: remaining HP damage allowance before the owner's next turn start
Invincible.effect: Caps cumulative HP damage, including HP loss. Damage consumes the remaining allowance; at zero, further damage is prevented. The stored reset cap restores the allowance at the owner's turn start, before start-of-turn damage such as Poison. The enemy definition supplies the initial allowance for the encounter's Ascension; the combat reading supplies the current remaining allowance.
Invincible.timing: Resets at the owner's turn start, not after every hit or at player turn end.

LoseStrength.amountUnit: Strength to subtract at owner's turn end
LoseStrength.effect: Subtract the stored amount from the owner's then-current Strength, then remove this power. This is a fixed subtraction, not a reset of Strength; other Strength gains remain except for that subtraction. Artifact can block application of this debuff.
LoseStrength.timing: Owner's turn end, once; not a recurring loss each round.

Malleable.amountUnit: Block gained by the next qualifying hit; stored base is the reset amount
Malleable.effect: Each nonlethal normal hit that causes positive HP loss queues Block equal to the current amount, then immediately increases the amount by 1. Fully blocked hits, lethal hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not trigger it. Counts hits, not cards; queued Block resolves at its existing queue position.
Malleable.timing: After the monster's turn ends, the amount resets to its stored base. Does not lose duration each round.

Minion.effect: Marks the owner as a minion and excludes it from unique kill-reward triggers. Its enemy behavior determines leader-death escape; in the {{entity_enemy_GremlinLeader}} encounter, other non-dying allies escape when the leader dies.
Minion.timing: Persistent marker; encounter behavior handles escape.

NextTurnBlock.amountUnit: accumulated Block to gain at the owner's next turn start
NextTurnBlock.effect: At the owner's next turn start, gain Block equal to amount, then remove this power. Multiple applications add to the same pending amount. The delayed Block does not protect during the turn when this power is applied.
NextTurnBlock.timing: Owner turn-start power hook, after normal Block clearing; consumed in one trigger.

NoBlock.amountUnit: remaining round-end ticks of card Block prevention
NoBlock.effect: Sets calculated Block from cards to 0. Block gained by powers and relics, such as {{entity_card_FeelNoPain}} and {{entity_card_Metallicize}}, still applies. Existing Block is not removed by application. Artifact can block this debuff.
NoBlock.timing: Decreases by 1 at each round end, including the round it was applied. {{entity_card_PanicButton}} applies 2, affecting further card Block this turn and next turn.

NoDraw.amountUnit: presence; not a numeric stack count
NoDraw.effect: Prevents further card draw while active, including card and power triggers such as {{entity_card_DarkEmbrace}} and {{entity_card_Evolve}}. It does not prevent adding generated cards to Hand or moving cards into Hand without drawing.
NoDraw.timing: Removed at the owner's turn end. {{entity_card_BattleTrance}} draws its cards before applying this power.

PainfulStabs.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
PainfulStabs.effect: Whenever the owner inflicts positive HP damage other than THORNS damage, add 1 Wound to the player's discard pile. Fully blocked hits add none; multiple damaging hits each add a Wound.

PlatedArmor.effect: Gain amount Block at turn end. Each incoming normal hit that actually loses HP from another entity removes 1 Plated Armor. Fully blocked hits, THORNS and HP-loss damage do not remove a stack. Removing the last stack stuns {{entity_enemy_ShelledParasite}}.
PlatedArmor.timing: Turn-end Block and on-HP-loss reduction; not a duration countdown.

Rage.amountUnit: Block gained per Attack card played
Rage.effect: When the player plays an Attack card, the owner gains Block equal to amount (at least 0). Triggers once per card, not once per hit; Skills and Powers do not trigger it.
Rage.timing: Active while present; removed at the end of the player turn. Amount is not a duration.

Reactive.amountUnit: presence flag (-1 is the runtime sentinel)
Reactive.effect: Each normal hit with a real source that causes positive HP loss while the owner survives queues a new monster move roll. Fully blocked and lethal hits, Thorns and HP-loss effects do not trigger it. Multi-hit attacks can cause multiple rolls.
Reactive.timing: After qualifying damage; persists until removed. The resulting visible intention replaces the earlier intention, so inspect it again after attacking.

Ritual.effect: Repeatedly grants amount Strength; the displayed amount is growth per trigger, not current Strength.
Ritual.timing: Player-controlled Ritual triggers at end of player turn. Monster Ritual triggers at end of round and skips its initial trigger.

Shackled.amountUnit: Strength restored at the owner's turn end
Shackled.effect: At the end of the owner's turn, apply amount Strength to the owner only if amount is positive, then remove Shackled. Non-positive amounts restore no Strength; Shackled is still removed. The Strength reduction is a separate effect, not performed by Shackled itself.
Shackled.timing: Removed at the owner's turn end, not an end-of-round duration counter.

SharpHide.amountUnit: Thorns damage per Attack card played
SharpHide.effect: When the player plays an Attack card, the owner deals amount Thorns damage to the player. Triggers once per card, not once per hit; Skills and Powers do not trigger it. Player Block can absorb this damage.
SharpHide.timing: Triggers only while present; no automatic round decay. Guardian removes it when leaving Defensive Mode.

Shifting.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Shifting.effect: Whenever normal or Thorns damage causes positive HP loss to the owner, apply that much negative Strength and an equal Shackled effect. Fully blocked hits and direct HP-loss effects do not trigger it. This reduces current attack damage, potentially to 0. Artifact can block the negative Strength application and prevents the matching Shackled application.
Shifting.timing: Strength reduction lasts through the owner's attack. Shackled restores the reduced Strength at the owner's turn end and removes itself; Shifting remains present.

Slow.amountUnit: card-play counter for the current round
Slow.effect: Player Attack card damage against this owner is multiplied by 1 + 0.1 times amount. Skills and Powers also increase the counter when played, so earlier setup cards can amplify later Attacks.
Slow.timing: Each player card play adds 1. At the end of the round, reset the amount to 0 and keep the power present. A turn-start reading of 0 is the reset counter; it can grow again during that turn.

Split.effect: For a living Large Slime or {{entity_enemy_SlimeBoss}}, reaching half Max HP or below replaces the current intent with Split. Each child's current and Max HP equal the parent's remaining HP at split execution. More damage before splitting reduces the children; killing the parent prevents splitting.
Split.timing: Checked after damage; Split executes on the enemy turn. Medium and Small Slimes do not split.

SporeCloud.effect: On death, applies amount Vulnerable to the player. This increases incoming attack damage; it does not apply Weak or reduce the player's attacks.
SporeCloud.timing: Death trigger is skipped when the battle is already ending. The amount here is the application size, not the player's remaining Vulnerable duration.

Strength.effect: Amount is signed: +2 adds 2 attack damage per hit, -2 subtracts 2, before multipliers. Strength reduction works from 0 Strength into negative Strength. {{entity_card_HeavyBlade}} scales this signed bonus with its card multiplier.
Strength.timing: Persists until another effect changes or removes it.

Surrounded.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Surrounded.effect: Targeting an enemy with a card turns the player toward it. An enemy behind the player deals 50% more attack damage. Untargeted cards do not turn the player. Actual damage uses facing and position; Back Attack is the visible marker. Ends when the surrounding pair is broken.
Surrounded.timing: Facing changes at targeted card play; remains while surrounded.

BackAttack.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
BackAttack.effect: Marks an enemy behind the Surrounded player. Its attacks deal 50% more damage. Targeted cards can change facing; actual damage follows facing, and this display marker refreshes when the card queue settles.
BackAttack.timing: Derived from player facing while Surrounded, not a stack-based damage modifier.

Thievery.amountUnit: Gold stolen per stealing move, capped by available Gold
Thievery.effect: The thief's stealing moves take Gold before attack damage; Block does not prevent theft. Killing the thief recovers its stolen Gold in rewards; escape does not.
Thievery.timing: Stealing moves only; not an automatic effect on every hit or turn. No round decay.

Thorns.effect: When attacked by another entity with normal damage, deal this much THORNS damage to the attacker, even when Block absorbs the hit. Multi-hit attacks trigger once per hit. THORNS and HP-loss damage do not trigger retaliation; Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify retaliation damage.

TimeWarp.amountUnit: card counter toward 12, retained across turns
TimeWarp.effect: Each counted player card increments the counter. The 12th forces the player's turn to end, resets the counter to 0, and gives all living enemies 2 permanent Strength. Ending a normal turn does not reset it. Potions are not card plays.
TimeWarp.timing: Card-play trigger and forced-end sequence; persists across turns.

Unawakened.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Unawakened.effect: {{entity_enemy_AwakenedOne}}'s first phase. First lethal damage starts Rebirth instead of final death: remove debuffs, Curiosity, Unawakened and Shackled; preserve positive Strength and Regenerate. Rebirth restores full HP without attacking; Dark Echo follows. The transition belongs to the monster's damage handler.
Unawakened.timing: Removed immediately at first-phase lethal damage.

Vulnerable.effect: Increases attack damage received, normally by 50%. More stacks extend duration, not the multiplier. {{entity_relic_PaperFrog}} and {{entity_relic_OddMushroom}} can change the multiplier.
Vulnerable.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick. The displayed amount is remaining duration, not the original application.

Weak.effect: Reduces attack damage dealt, normally by 25%. Paper Crane makes enemy Weak stronger. More stacks extend duration, not the multiplier.
Weak.timing: Decreases by 1 at end of round, unless the newly-applied flag skips that tick.

Combust.amountUnit: damage to each enemy; separate self HP loss is stored alongside it
Combust.effect: At player turn end, first lose the stored self HP loss, then deal amount non-Attack damage to each enemy. Block does not prevent the self HP loss. Each additional deployment adds its damage and 1 to self HP loss; this loss can trigger Rupture.
Combust.timing: Player turn end; persists for the rest of combat. Damage and self HP loss stack independently.

Corruption.amountUnit: presence; not a numeric stack count
Corruption.effect: While active, Skills cost 0 and Exhaust when played, including Skills that normally do not Exhaust. It does not draw cards or give Energy. Attacks and Powers keep their own costs and destinations. Owning the Corruption card is not the same as having this active power.
Corruption.timing: Takes effect when deployed and persists for the rest of combat. Additional Corruption applications do not multiply this effect.

DarkEmbrace.effect: While active, whenever any card is Exhausted, draw amount cards. Multiple deployed copies add their amounts: amount 2 draws 2 per Exhaust. Does not give Energy. No Draw prevents the draw; no further draw is queued once combat has ended.
DarkEmbrace.timing: On Exhaust, after deployment; persists for the rest of combat. Merely owning or holding the card does not activate this trigger.

FeelNoPain.effect: While active, whenever any card is Exhausted, gain amount Block. Multiple deployed copies add their amounts. This trigger does not draw cards or give Energy; Dexterity and Frail do not modify this power's Block.
FeelNoPain.timing: On Exhaust, after deployment; persists for the rest of combat. The Block itself follows ordinary Block lifetime rules.

FlameBarrier.effect: When another entity attacks the owner with normal damage, deal amount THORNS damage to the attacker, even when Block absorbs the hit. Multi-hit attacks trigger once per hit. Self damage, THORNS and HP-loss damage do not trigger it. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify retaliation damage.
FlameBarrier.timing: On-attacked trigger; removed at the start of the owner's next turn. Multiple applications add their amounts until that removal.

Metallicize.amountUnit: Block gained at each owner's turn end
Metallicize.effect: Gain amount Block at the end of the owner's turn. Does not decay each round; {{entity_enemy_Lagavulin}} removes its sleeping {{entity_card_Metallicize}} when it wakes.
Metallicize.timing: Owner turn end, not on card play or damage. For the player, end-of-turn relic checks such as {{entity_relic_Orichalcum}} happen before this Block gain; this gain then precedes queued end-of-turn Status and Curse effects.

Regrow.amountUnit: presence flag, not a numeric stack count
Regrow.effect: {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}s enter half-death at 0 HP while another {{entity_enemy_Darkling}} is still alive. Their powers are cleared, their current move becomes the idle Count, and they cannot be targeted. After Count, Reincarnate restores floor(Max HP / 2) HP, revives the monster and reinstalls Life Link. Bringing all {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}s to 0 HP before any revives kills the group permanently.
Regrow.timing: Half-death and group defeat are owned by {{entity_enemy_Darkling}}'s death handler; revival occurs on its Reincarnate move. This is not an end-of-turn regeneration amount.

ModeShift.amountUnit: remaining HP damage to trigger Defensive Mode
ModeShift.effect: Actual HP loss reduces the remaining amount; damage absorbed by Block does not. Reaching the threshold replaces the current intent with Close Up, removes Mode Shift and grants Defensive Block. The next threshold increases each time; see the Guardian definition for difficulty-specific amounts.
ModeShift.timing: Active in Offensive Mode; restored with the new threshold after Twin Slam. No round decay.

cardRule.Pain: Unplayable. While this card is in your hand, lose 1 HP whenever you play another card; each {{entity_card_Pain}} copy triggers separately. Block does not prevent this HP loss. Discarding or Exhausting it removes this trigger until it returns to hand; combat Exhaust does not remove it from your permanent deck.
cardRule.Parasite: Unplayable. No draw or end-of-turn effect; discarded normally if left in hand. Removing it from your master deck loses 3 Max HP. Exhausting it during combat does not remove it from your master deck and does not lose Max HP.
cardRule.Writhe: Unplayable. Innate: starts in your opening hand each combat, occupying a hand slot. No draw or end-of-turn effect; discarded normally if left in hand. Does not Exhaust itself.
cardRule.Decay: Unplayable. If still in hand at the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to yourself before the ordinary hand discard. Block can absorb this damage. The card is discarded normally and can return in later draws; discarding or Exhausting it before this trigger avoids the damage. Combat Exhaust does not remove it from your permanent deck.
cardRule.Normality: Unplayable. While this card is in your hand, you cannot play a card after already playing 3 cards this turn. The count includes cards played before Normality reached your hand. Removing it from hand by discard or Exhaust lifts its restriction; it does not reset the turn's card count. Potions and ending the turn are not card plays.
cardRule.Injury: Unplayable. Occupies a draw and Hand slot; has no additional combat effect.
cardRule.Regret: Unplayable. If still in Hand at the end of your turn, lose HP equal to the Hand size when its end-turn effect is queued, including Regret itself. Block does not prevent this HP loss.
cardRule.Clumsy: Unplayable. Ethereal: Exhaust if still in Hand at the end of your turn. Occupies a draw and Hand slot until then.
cardRule.CurseOfTheBell: Unplayable. Occupies a draw and Hand slot; has no additional combat effect. Cannot be selected for ordinary permanent removal or transformation.
cardRule.Doubt: Unplayable. If still in Hand at the end of your turn, apply 1 Weak to yourself. Artifact can block this application.
cardRule.Shame: Unplayable. If still in Hand at the end of your turn, apply 1 Frail to yourself. Artifact can block this application.
cardRule.Pride: Innate. If still in Hand at the end of your turn, put one temporary Pride on top of the draw pile. Costs 1 Energy to play and Exhaust; playing it has no additional effect. Copies generated during combat do not enter the permanent deck.
cardRule.Miracle: Gain 1 Energy (2 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy. Retain. Exhaust.
cardRule.Insight: Draw 2 cards (3 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy. Retain. Exhaust. Draw prevention and hand capacity still apply.
cardRule.Shiv: Deal 4 damage to one enemy (6 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.Strike: Deal 6 damage to one enemy (9 if upgraded).
cardRule.JAX: Lose 3 HP, then gain 2 Strength (3 if upgraded) for the rest of combat. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust; Block does not prevent the self HP loss.
cardRule.Apparition: Gain 1 Intangible, reducing incoming damage and HP loss to 1 per instance while active. Exhaust. Ethereal when unupgraded; upgrading removes Ethereal but does not remove Exhaust.
cardRule.Apotheosis: Upgrade every upgradeable card in hand, draw pile, discard pile and exhaust pile for this combat only, then Exhaust. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded). Does not upgrade the master deck or the currently playing card in limbo; already upgraded cards are skipped except repeat-upgradeable {{entity_card_SearingBlow}}.
cardRule.Bite: Deal 7 damage to one enemy, then heal 2 HP (8 damage and 3 HP if upgraded). Healing is a fixed amount per play, subject to healing modifiers and the Max HP cap.
cardRule.RitualDagger: Deal damage equal to this copy's stored misc value, initially 15. If this hit kills a non-Minion enemy that is not entering a half-dead phase, permanently increase this copy's stored damage by 3 (5 if upgraded). The increase follows its lineage into the master deck and matching combat copies. Costs 1 Energy. Exhaust. Upgrading increases kill growth, not the current damage.
cardRule.BandageUp: Heal 4 HP (6 if upgraded), up to Max HP and subject to healing modifiers. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust. This heals HP directly rather than gaining Block.
cardRule.Madness: Set one randomly selected eligible card in Hand to cost 0 for this combat. Prefers cards with a positive current turn cost; if none exist, uses a card whose combat cost is still positive. Costs 1 Energy (0 if upgraded). Exhaust.
cardRule.Blind: Apply 2 Weak to one enemy (all enemies if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust. Artifact can block each enemy's debuff application.
cardRule.DarkShackles: Reduce one enemy's Strength by 9 (15 if upgraded) for its next turn, then restore that amount at the end of that enemy's turn. Artifact can block the Strength reduction. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.DramaticEntrance: Deal 8 damage to all enemies (12 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy. Innate. Exhaust.
cardRule.Enlightenment: Reduce costs greater than 1 on eligible cards currently in Hand to 1 for this turn (for this combat if upgraded). X-cost and unplayable cards are unaffected. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust. Only the current Hand is changed.
cardRule.Impatience: If no Attack cards remain in Hand when this effect resolves, draw 2 cards (3 if upgraded). Otherwise draw none. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.JackOfAllTrades: Add 1 random Colorless card to Hand (2 if upgraded). The generated cards keep their normal costs and are temporary for this combat; hand capacity applies. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.MindBlast: Deal base damage equal to the number of cards currently in the draw pile, then apply ordinary Attack modifiers. Innate. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded) and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.Trip: Apply 2 Vulnerable to one enemy (all enemies if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust. Artifact can block each enemy's debuff application.
cardRule.Chrysalis: Insert 3 random Skills from your class at random positions in the draw pile (5 if upgraded). These temporary cards cost 0 for this combat and must still be drawn to reach Hand. Costs 2 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.HandOfGreed: Deal 20 damage to one enemy (25 if upgraded). If this hit kills a non-Minion enemy that is not entering a half-dead phase, gain 20 Gold (25 if upgraded), subject to gold-gain rules. Costs 2 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.Magnetism: For the rest of combat, at each turn start from the next turn onward, add 1 random temporary Colorless card to Hand per stack. Generated cards keep their normal costs; hand capacity applies. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded).
cardRule.Metamorphosis: Insert 3 random Attacks from your class at random positions in the draw pile (5 if upgraded). These temporary cards cost 0 for this combat and must still be drawn to reach Hand. Costs 2 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.ThinkingAhead: Draw 2 cards, then choose 1 card from Hand to put on top of the draw pile. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust when unupgraded; upgrading removes Exhaust. The returned card must be drawn again to reach Hand.
cardRule.DeepBreath: Shuffle your discard pile into your draw pile, then draw 1 card (2 if upgraded). If the discard pile is empty when played, only draw; do not shuffle. The playing Deep Breath is not included in this shuffle or draw, and is normally discarded after its effects. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.Forethought: Choose 1 other card in Hand (any number if upgraded, including none) and put the chosen cards on the bottom of the draw pile. A chosen card with positive combat cost becomes free for its next play; this uses its cost before a temporary turn-only override. Zero-cost, X-cost and unplayable cards can be moved but receive no free-play benefit. This card does not draw the moved cards. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.SwiftStrike: Deal 7 damage to one enemy (10 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.TheBomb: Costs 2 Energy. Apply a 3-turn countdown: at the end of your third turn, deal 40 non-Attack damage to all enemies (50 if upgraded). The turn this card is played counts as the first turn. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not modify this delayed THORNS damage; enemy Block and damage caps still apply. The card itself does not Exhaust unless another effect makes it do so.
cardRule.PanicButton: Costs 0 Energy. Gain 30 Block (40 if upgraded), then apply 2 No Block to yourself. No Block sets calculated Block from cards to 0 while active; Block from powers such as {{entity_power_FeelNoPain}} and {{entity_power_Metallicize}} still works. Its duration ticks at each round end, including this round, so it affects further card Block this turn and next turn. Artifact can prevent this debuff. Exhaust.
cardRule.Transmutation: X-cost Skill. Spend all current Energy to add X random Colorless cards to your hand; {{entity_relic_ChemicalX}} adds 2 to the number generated. Generated cards cost 0 this turn and are upgraded if Transmutation is upgraded. Hand capacity applies, with overflow sent to discard. These are temporary combat cards, not additions to the master deck. Exhaust.
cardRule.Purity: Choose up to 3 other cards in your hand to Exhaust (up to 5 if upgraded); choosing zero is allowed. Costs 0 Energy. Purity itself also Exhausts. Does not remove any card from your permanent deck.
cardRule.Panache: Costs 0 Energy. For the rest of combat, every 5 cards played in a single turn deals 10 non-Attack damage to all enemies (14 if upgraded). Counts cards, not damage hits; multiple groups of 5 can trigger, and the card counter resets each turn. Does not grant Energy or draw cards.
cardRule.Discovery: Choose one of three distinct randomly offered cards from your class's combat-generation pool (healing-tagged cards are excluded). Add a temporary copy to your hand; it costs 0 this turn. Costs 1 Energy. Exhaust when unupgraded; upgrading removes Exhaust.
cardRule.SecretWeapon: Choose one Attack card in your draw pile and move it to your hand. Costs 0 Energy. Cannot play if the draw pile has no Attack. Exhaust when unupgraded; upgrading removes Exhaust.
cardRule.SecretTechnique: Choose one Skill card currently in your draw pile and move it to your hand, with its existing cost. Costs 0 Energy. Cannot play if the draw pile has no Skill. Exhaust when unupgraded; upgrading removes Exhaust.
cardRule.Panacea: Gain 1 Artifact (2 if upgraded). Artifact blocks future debuff applications, consuming one charge per application. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.FlashOfSteel: Deal 3 damage to one enemy (6 if upgraded), then draw 1 card. Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust.
cardRule.Mayhem: For the rest of combat, after your normal start-of-turn draw, automatically play the top card of your remaining draw pile for free (a random enemy target if needed). Each stack plays one card. Does not force Exhaust; the played card keeps its own Exhaust rule. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded).
cardRule.Bash: Deal 8 damage (10 if upgraded), then apply 2 Vulnerable (3 if upgraded). The new Vulnerable does not increase this hit's damage.
cardRule.Anger: Deal 6 damage (8 if upgraded), then add a copy of this card to your discard pile. This combat-only copy is not added to your permanent master deck and disappears after combat. The original card is also discarded normally after play.
cardRule.Barricade: For the rest of combat, your Block is not removed at the start of your turn. Costs 3 Energy (2 if upgraded).
cardRule.Bludgeon: Deal 32 damage to one enemy (42 if upgraded).
cardRule.Brutality: At the start of each turn, after the normal draw, draw 1 additional card and lose 1 HP. Upgraded: Innate, so it starts in your opening hand.
cardRule.BurningPact: Choose and Exhaust 1 other card from your hand, then draw 2 cards (3 if upgraded). Burning Pact itself does not Exhaust unless another effect, such as {{entity_card_Corruption}}, makes it do so; it can be drawn and played again. If no other card is in hand, the draw still occurs. Pact grants no Energy; any Energy gain needs a separate trigger, such as the selected {{entity_card_Sentinel}}'s own on-Exhaust effect.
cardRule.Carnage: Deal 20 damage (28 if upgraded). Ethereal: Exhaust if still in hand at the end of your turn; playing it does not Exhaust it.
cardRule.Clash: Can only be played if every card in your hand is an Attack; Skills, Powers, Statuses and Curses prevent play. Deal 14 damage (18 if upgraded).
cardRule.Combust: At the end of each turn, lose 1 HP, then deal 5 non-Attack damage to all enemies (7 if upgraded). Additional applications add both HP loss and damage.
cardRule.DarkEmbrace: For the rest of combat, whenever a card is Exhausted, draw 1 card per stack of Dark Embrace. Each play adds 1 stack, so two plays draw 2 per Exhaust; replaying with {{entity_power_DuplicationPower}} also adds a stack. Draw prevention and hand capacity still apply. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded).
cardRule.DemonForm: At the start of each of your turns from the next turn onward, gain 2 Strength (3 if upgraded). Does not grant Strength immediately when played.
cardRule.Disarm: Reduce one enemy's current Strength by 2 (3 if upgraded). Strength can become negative: a target at 0 becomes -2 (-3 if upgraded). This persistent reduction affects each later attack hit, including across turns; ordinary Strength gains add to the reduced amount. An effect that explicitly clears debuffs can remove negative Strength. Artifact can block the application. Exhaust.
cardRule.DoubleTap: This turn, replay each of the next 1 Attack cards you play (2 if upgraded) once against the same target, without paying its cost again. Unused replays expire at turn end.
cardRule.Evolve: For the rest of combat, whenever you draw a Status card, draw 1 additional card (2 if upgraded). Curses do not trigger this effect.
cardRule.FireBreathing: For the rest of combat, whenever you draw a Status or Curse, deal 6 non-Attack damage to all enemies (10 if upgraded).
cardRule.Flex: Gain 2 Strength (4 if upgraded), then apply an equal Lose Strength effect that removes that Strength at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the Lose Strength debuff.
cardRule.GhostlyArmor: Gain 10 Block (13 if upgraded). Ethereal: Exhaust if still in hand at the end of your turn; playing it does not Exhaust it.
cardRule.Headbutt: Deal 9 damage (12 if upgraded), then put 1 card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile. Choose when multiple cards are eligible; no card is moved if discard is empty. This does not draw the card.
cardRule.HeavyBlade: Deal 14 base damage. Strength contributes 3 times its usual amount (5 times if upgraded); this is one hit, not multiple hits.
cardRule.Hemokinesis: Lose 2 HP, then deal 15 damage to one enemy (20 if upgraded). Block does not prevent the self HP loss.
cardRule.GoodInstincts: Gain 6 Block (9 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy and does not Exhaust. Block follows current Dexterity and Frail modifiers.
cardRule.MasterOfStrategy: Draw 3 cards (4 if upgraded). Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust. Draw prevention and hand capacity still apply.
cardRule.Necronomicurse: Unplayable. When Exhausted during combat, add a new temporary Necronomicurse to your hand. Permanent removal normally regenerates it in the master deck while {{entity_relic_Necronomicon}} is held.
cardRule.InfernalBlade: Add 1 random Attack from your class pool to Hand; overflow goes to Discard. The generated card is temporary for this combat and costs 0 this turn. At turn end its ordinary cost returns; it follows its own play conditions and lifecycle. Exhaust. Costs 1 Energy (0 if upgraded).
cardRule.Inflame: Gain 2 Strength (3 if upgraded) for the rest of combat.
cardRule.Intimidate: Apply 1 Weak to all enemies (2 if upgraded). Exhaust.
cardRule.LimitBreak: Double your current Strength, including negative Strength. Gives no Strength if you have none. Exhaust when unupgraded; no longer Exhausts when upgraded.
cardRule.Offering: Lose 6 HP, then gain 2 Energy, then draw 3 cards (5 if upgraded). Block does not prevent the self HP loss. Exhaust.
cardRule.PerfectedStrike: Deal 6 base damage plus 2 for each Strike-tagged card in hand, draw and discard, including this card (3 per card if upgraded). Exhausted cards do not count.
cardRule.Pummel: Deal 2 damage to one enemy 4 times (5 if upgraded). Each hit benefits from Strength. Exhaust.
cardRule.Reaper: Deal 4 base Attack damage to all enemies (5 if upgraded), modified by Strength, Weak, Vulnerable and other damage effects. Heal for their total actual HP lost after Block, remaining HP and damage limits such as {{entity_power_Invincible}}. Healing modifiers such as {{entity_relic_MagicFlower}} apply to that total. Exhaust; using it once removes this copy from later combat draws unless another effect returns it.
cardRule.RecklessCharge: Deal 7 damage (10 if upgraded), then insert 1 {{entity_card_Dazed}} at a random position in your draw pile. Upgrading does not remove the {{entity_card_Dazed}}.
cardRule.SearingBlow: Deal 12 damage at upgrade count 0. Can be upgraded repeatedly: base damage is 12 + n*(n+7)/2 at upgrade count n (16, 21, 27 for the first three upgrades).
cardRule.SecondWind: Exhaust all non-Attack cards remaining in your hand, then gain 5 Block separately for each card Exhausted (7 if upgraded). Skills, Powers, Statuses and Curses qualify; Attack cards stay in hand.
cardRule.SeeingRed: Gain 2 Energy. Exhaust. Costs 1 Energy (0 if upgraded), so the net Energy gain is 1 (2 if upgraded) at the printed cost.
cardRule.Shockwave: Apply 3 Weak, then 3 Vulnerable to each enemy (5 of each if upgraded). Each debuff can consume a separate Artifact charge. Exhaust.
cardRule.SwordBoomerang: Deal 3 damage 3 times (4 if upgraded). Each hit chooses a random living enemy independently and benefits from Strength; you cannot select the target.
cardRule.ThunderClap: Deal 4 damage to all enemies (7 if upgraded), then apply 1 Vulnerable to all enemies. The new Vulnerable does not increase these hits' damage.
cardRule.TwinStrike: Deal 5 damage to one enemy twice (7 per hit if upgraded). Each hit benefits from Strength.
cardRule.WildStrike: Deal 12 damage (17 if upgraded), then insert 1 {{entity_card_Wound}} at a random position in your draw pile. Upgrading does not remove the {{entity_card_Wound}}.
cardRule.Wound: Unplayable. No draw or end-of-turn effect; it is discarded normally if still in hand, and remains in combat until removed by another effect.
cardRule.Burn: Unplayable. If still in hand at the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to yourself (4 if upgraded). Block can absorb this damage; Burn is then discarded normally.
cardRule.Slimed: Costs 1 Energy to play and Exhaust; has no other effect. If left in hand, it is discarded normally.
cardRule.Void: Unplayable. When drawn, lose 1 Energy. Ethereal: Exhaust if still in hand at the end of your turn.
cardRule.AscendersBane: Unplayable. Ethereal: Exhaust if still in hand at the end of your turn. Cannot be removed from your master deck.
cardRule.Dazed: Unplayable. Ethereal: if still in hand at the end of the player turn, it exhausts. Dazed in the draw or discard pile stays there until another effect moves it; adding Dazed does not immediately exhaust it.
cardRule.Cleave: Deal 8 damage to all enemies (11 if upgraded).
cardRule.Whirlwind: Deal 5 damage to all enemies X times (8 if upgraded); X is the Energy spent.
cardRule.Havoc: Play the top card of your draw pile with a random enemy target, and Exhaust it after play. A playable Power is applied normally and stays active; it is not lost before activation or moved to Exhaust. Fixed Energy costs are not paid; X-cost cards use remaining Energy and retain their own Energy spending rule. If the draw pile is empty, shuffle discard first. Ordinary autoplay playability checks apply. Costs 0 if upgraded.
cardRule.Warcry: Draw 1 card (2 if upgraded), then put 1 card from your hand on top of the draw pile. The top-deck step still occurs if drawing is prevented. Exhaust.
cardRule.Rampage: Deal 8 damage. Afterwards, increase this card instance's damage by 5 (8 if upgraded) for the rest of combat.
cardRule.BloodForBlood: Deal 18 damage (22 if upgraded). Base cost is 4 (3 if upgraded). Each positive HP-loss event reduces this instance's cost by 1 while it is in hand, draw or discard, to a minimum of 0, for this combat. Blocked or prevented HP loss does not reduce cost.
cardRule.Dropkick: Deal 5 damage (8 if upgraded). When the attack resolves, check whether its target has Vulnerable before damage; if so, queue damage, gain 1 Energy, then draw 1 card. Energy and draw are conditional, not guaranteed on play.
cardRule.DualWield: Create 1 additional copy (2 if upgraded) of an Attack or Power in your hand. With one eligible card, keep the original and add copies; with multiple eligible cards, select one and replace it with 2 copies (3 if upgraded). Both branches have the same net copy gain before the hand limit. No eligible card produces no copies; hand capacity applies.
cardRule.Exhume: Return 1 card other than {{entity_card_Exhume}} from your exhaust pile to your hand. The exhaust pile and hand capacity are checked when the effect resolves. Exhaust. Costs 0 if upgraded.
cardRule.Rupture: Whenever you lose HP from your own card, gain 1 Strength (2 if upgraded).
cardRule.FeelNoPain: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain 3 Block (4 if upgraded).
cardRule.Finesse: Gain 2 Block (4 if upgraded), then draw 1 card.
cardRule.Violence: Move 3 randomly chosen Attack cards from your draw pile to your hand (4 if upgraded), or all eligible cards if fewer remain. This moves cards rather than performing ordinary draws and does not reshuffle an empty draw pile. Cards that exceed the 10-card hand limit go to discard. Costs 0 Energy. Exhaust.
cardRule.SadisticNature: When you apply a debuff to an enemy without Artifact, deal 5 damage (7 if upgraded).
cardRule.Uppercut: Deal 13 damage, then apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable (2 of each if upgraded). Costs 2 Energy. Resolves damage first, then applies Weak, then Vulnerable. Its new Vulnerable does not increase its own damage. Each debuff can consume a separate Artifact charge. With one Artifact charge and no prior Vulnerable, Weak is blocked and Vulnerable applies after the damage.
cardRule.FlameBarrier: Gain 12 Block (16 if upgraded) and 4 retaliation damage per incoming attack hit (6 if upgraded). Each qualifying incoming attack hit causes retaliation, even if Block absorbs its damage. The retaliation power expires at the start of the next player turn. Card plays and retaliation hits are different counts.
cardRule.Metallicize: At the end of each player turn, gain 3 Block (4 if upgraded). The Block is available against that turn's enemy actions.
cardRule.Bloodletting: Lose 3 HP, then gain 2 Energy (3 if upgraded). The HP loss occurs before the Energy gain.
cardRule.Armaments: Gain 5 Block, then upgrade one card in hand for this combat. When upgraded, Armaments upgrades every card currently in hand instead.
cardRule.BattleTrance: Draw 3 cards (4 if upgraded), then prevent further card draw for the rest of this turn.
cardRule.SeverSoul: Exhaust all non-Attack cards remaining in hand, then deal 16 damage (22 if upgraded) to one enemy. Attack cards stay in hand.
cardRule.PowerThrough: Add 2 {{entity_card_Wound}}s to your hand, then gain 15 Block (20 if upgraded).
cardRule.ShrugItOff: Gain 8 Block (11 if upgraded), then draw 1 card. Block follows the current Dexterity and Frail modifiers.
cardRule.TrueGrit: Gain 7 Block (9 if upgraded), then Exhaust 1 other card from hand. The card is random when unupgraded; choose it when upgraded. Block follows current Dexterity and Frail modifiers.
cardRule.Feed: Deal 10 damage (12 if upgraded) and Exhaust. If this hit kills a non-Minion enemy that is not half-dead, gain 3 Max HP (4 if upgraded) and heal by the same amount. Killing a Minion does not grant Max HP.
cardRule.Rage: For the rest of this turn, gain 3 Block (5 if upgraded) each time you play an Attack. Rage is removed at the end of the turn.
cardRule.Sentinel: Gain 5 Block (8 if upgraded). If this card is Exhausted, gain 2 Energy (3 if upgraded); playing it does not Exhaust it.
cardRule.Berserk: When played, apply 2 turns of Vulnerable to yourself once (1 turn if upgraded); its duration decreases at the end of each round. Separately, gain 1 Energy at the start of each of your turns from the next turn onward for this combat.
cardRule.Immolate: Deal 21 damage to all enemies (28 if upgraded), then add 1 {{entity_card_Burn}} to the discard pile.
cardRule.Juggernaut: Whenever you gain Block, deal 5 damage (7 if upgraded) to a random enemy. Each separate Block gain triggers once, regardless of the amount gained.
cardRule.BodySlam: Use current Block as base Attack damage, then apply Strength, Weak, the target's Vulnerable and other damage modifiers. Playing Body Slam preserves your Block. Costs 1 Energy (0 if upgraded).
cardRule.SpotWeakness: If the targeted enemy has an Attack intent when this effect resolves, gain 3 Strength (4 if upgraded); otherwise gain none.
cardRule.Clothesline: Deal 12 damage (14 if upgraded), then apply 2 Weak (3 if upgraded). The new Weak applies after this hit.
cardRule.PommelStrike: Deal 9 damage (10 if upgraded), then draw 1 card (2 if upgraded). It has the Strike tag.
cardRule.IronWave: Gain 5 Block (7 if upgraded), then deal 5 damage (7 if upgraded) to one enemy. Block resolves before the hit; each uses its own combat modifiers.
cardRule.FiendFire: Exhaust all other cards in your hand, then deal 7 damage (10 if upgraded) to one enemy once for each card Exhausted. Each hit benefits from Strength.
cardRule.Entrench: Double your current Block. Costs 2 Energy (1 if upgraded).
cardRule.Corruption: For the rest of combat, Skills cost 0 and Exhaust when played, including upgraded Skills that normally do not Exhaust. Costs 3 Energy (2 if upgraded).

relicRule.Astrolabe: Choose 3 cards to transform; the replacements are upgraded.
relicRule.Pantograph: At the start of each boss combat, heal 25 HP.
relicRule.IncenseBurner: On pickup, the turn counter starts at 0. At the start of each player turn, increment it by 1; at 6, reset it to 0 and gain 1 Intangible. The counter persists between combats, so the next fight's protection timing depends on the previous fight's ending counter. The displayed counter counts elapsed turn starts since the last trigger.
relicRule.ChampionBelt: Whenever you successfully apply Vulnerable to an enemy, also apply 1 Weak to that enemy. If Artifact blocks the Vulnerable application, Champion Belt does not trigger. The added Weak is a separate debuff and can itself be blocked by another Artifact charge.
relicRule.EternalFeather: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, heal 3 HP for every complete group of 5 cards in your master deck, up to Max HP. This happens on entry even if you then choose Smith or Recall instead of Rest.
relicRule.AncientTeaSet: After entering a campfire, gain 2 extra Energy on the first turn of the next combat. Entering the campfire is sufficient; choosing Rest is not required. This is not extra Energy every turn.
relicRule.Lantern: Gain 1 additional Energy on the first turn of every combat. Later turns do not receive this bonus. Its first-turn flag resets before each combat; a currently spent flag does not mean the relic is permanently consumed.
relicRule.Anchor: At the start of each combat, gain 10 Block. This protects the opening turn; it is not recurring Block every turn.
relicRule.ArtOfWar: If you played no Attack cards during a player turn, gain 1 additional Energy at the start of your next player turn. This gives no first-turn bonus. Any played Attack counts, including 0-cost Attacks; damage from Skills, Powers or potions does not cancel the bonus. The condition is checked anew each turn.
relicRule.Brimstone: At the start of every player turn, including the first, gain 2 Strength and give each enemy 1 Strength. These gains persist for the combat and repeat each turn. Strength modifies each attack hit, so enemy multi-hit attacks also gain damage per hit.
relicRule.Pocketwatch: If you played 3 or fewer cards during a player turn, draw 3 additional cards at the start of the next player turn, after the normal draw. Gives no first-turn bonus. Counts cards played, not attack hits; the counter resets each turn. Draw prevention and the 10-card hand limit still apply.
relicRule.LizardTail: Once per run, when lethal HP loss would defeat you, heal for 50% of Max HP, rounded down with a minimum healing request of 1. Healing modifiers and restrictions apply; {{entity_relic_MarkOfTheBloom}} prevents revival. After triggering, the relic is used up for the rest of the run.
relicRule.GremlinHorn: When an enemy dies while another living enemy remains, gain 1 Energy, then draw 1 card. Draw prevention and hand capacity still apply. This can trigger for multiple kills; escaped enemies do not count.
relicRule.HandDrill: When damage breaks an enemy's positive Block down to 0, apply 2 Vulnerable to that enemy after the hit. Artifact can block this debuff. The new Vulnerable does not amplify the block-breaking hit itself.
relicRule.StrikeDummy: Attack cards with the actual Strike tag deal 3 additional damage per hit, before later damage modifiers. This is a card-specific damage bonus, not Strength; other attacks receive no bonus. It applies to tagged cards such as {{entity_card_Strike}}, {{entity_card_PommelStrike}} and {{entity_card_PerfectedStrike}}.
relicRule.Necronomicon: Each turn, replay your first qualifying Attack for free against the same target: its current cost for the turn must be at least 2 and it must not be a free-to-play card, or an X-cost Attack must spend at least 2 Energy. The replay applies the card's effects again. On pickup, add {{entity_card_Necronomicurse}} to the permanent deck; this Curse regenerates when normally removed while Necronomicon is held.
relicRule.Enchiridion: At the start of each combat, add a temporary random Power card from your class to your hand. It costs 0 that turn. Its Power effect applies only after you play it; the generated card is not added to your permanent deck.
relicRule.NilrysCodex: At the end of each player turn, choose one of 3 randomly offered class cards to insert as a temporary copy at a random position in your draw pile, or skip. It supplies a future draw option rather than drawing the card immediately, and does not change your permanent deck.
relicRule.Torii: When a normal enemy hit would deal 2-5 unblocked damage to you, reduce that damage to 1. Checks each hit after Block, so a larger hit can qualify after partial Block or Weak reduces it. HP-loss and Thorns damage do not qualify.
relicRule.TungstenRod: Reduce each positive HP-loss event by 1, to a minimum of 0. Applied after Block and other damage modifiers, including {{entity_relic_Torii}}, and also applies to direct HP loss such as {{entity_card_Offering}}. {{entity_relic_Torii}} reducing a qualifying hit to 1 lets Tungsten Rod reduce its final HP loss to 0. Heart's {{entity_power_BeatOfDeath}} is reduced only when it would reach HP after Block. Effects triggered by actual HP loss use the reduced amount.
relicRule.UnceasingTop: During your turn, when the hand is empty after queued actions finish, draw 1 card. Can trigger again if you empty the hand again. Requires cards available to draw or reshuffle, and drawing to be allowed; No Draw prevents it. It supplies no Energy for the drawn card. Unplayable or unaffordable cards left in hand prevent the empty-hand trigger.
relicRule.RegalPillow: Whenever you Rest at a campfire, heal 15 additional HP, up to Max HP and subject to healing restrictions. It does not heal when choosing Smith or another campfire action.
relicRule.ChemicalX: Your X-cost card effects use X + 2 while spending the ordinary X Energy. This increases the effect amount; it does not grant 2 Energy or affect fixed-cost cards.
relicRule.Sling: At the start of elite combats only, gain 2 Strength. Does not grant Strength in normal or boss combats, including the Heart.
relicRule.BloodyIdol: Whenever you successfully gain a positive amount of Gold, heal 5 HP, up to Max HP and subject to healing restrictions. Combat gold triggers this when claimed; merely winning does not trigger it.
relicRule.MummifiedHand: Whenever you play a Power, one randomly chosen eligible card remaining in your hand costs 0 for this turn. The card must have a positive printed cost and a positive current cost; X-cost, unplayable and already-free cards are not eligible. Does not draw cards or make the played Power free.
relicRule.Waffle: On pickup, gain 7 Max HP and heal to Max HP, subject to healing restrictions. Has no recurring combat effect.
relicRule.SingingBowl: At a card reward, you may gain 2 Max HP instead of taking a card. This consumes that card reward and also requests 2 HP healing, subject to healing restrictions.
relicRule.FrozenEgg: Whenever you add a Power card to your deck, upgrade it.
relicRule.MoltenEgg: Whenever you add an Attack card to your deck, upgrade it. Existing deck cards are not upgraded on pickup.
relicRule.ToxicEgg: Whenever you add a Skill card to your deck, upgrade it. Existing deck cards are not upgraded on pickup.
relicRule.Courier: Shop card, relic and potion prices are 20% lower. Card removal is also discounted unless another relic overrides its price; use the displayed price after all modifiers. Purchased cards, relics and potions are immediately replaced by new stock. Inspect the returned stock and prices after each purchase. Card removal remains limited to once per shop.
relicRule.MembershipCard: Shop card, relic and potion prices are 50% lower, stacking with {{entity_relic_Courier}}'s item discount. Card removal is also discounted, with overrides such as {{entity_relic_SmilingMask}}; use the displayed removal price. Buying Membership Card immediately discounts the remaining inventory in this shop. Inspect the updated prices after purchase.
relicRule.MagicFlower: Healing during combat is 50% more effective, rounded to the nearest whole HP and capped by missing HP. This includes {{entity_card_Reaper}}, healing potions used in combat, and combat-end healing from {{entity_relic_BurningBlood}} (6 becomes 9) or {{entity_relic_BlackBlood}} (12 becomes 18). Does not increase out-of-combat recovery such as campfire Rest or {{entity_relic_EternalFeather}}.
relicRule.StrangeSpoon: Whenever a played non-Power card would Exhaust after use, it has a 50% chance to be discarded instead. Cards saved this way do not trigger on-Exhaust effects such as {{entity_card_DarkEmbrace}}, {{entity_card_FeelNoPain}} or {{entity_card_Sentinel}}. Does not save other cards Exhausted by a card effect, or cards that Exhaust because of Ethereal at turn end. With {{entity_card_Corruption}}, saved Skills remain reusable at 0 cost while {{entity_card_Corruption}} is active, but provide no on-Exhaust payoff on that saved play.
relicRule.PreservedInsect: At the start of elite combats, reduce each enemy's current HP to at most 75% of its Max HP, rounded down. Does not reduce Max HP or affect normal and boss combats.
relicRule.BottledFlame: On pickup: choose an eligible Attack card in your deck. The selected copy keeps its upgrade and is placed at the top of the draw pile for the normal opening draw each combat. It occupies one opening-hand slot; its Energy cost must still be paid when played.
relicRule.BottledLightning: On pickup: choose an eligible Skill card in your deck. The selected copy keeps its upgrade and is placed at the top of the draw pile for the normal opening draw each combat. It occupies one opening-hand slot; its Energy cost must still be paid when played.
relicRule.BottledTornado: On pickup: choose an eligible Power card in your deck. The selected copy keeps its upgrade and is placed at the top of the draw pile for the normal opening draw each combat. It occupies one opening-hand slot; its Energy cost must still be paid when played.
relicRule.WarpedTongs: After your start-of-turn draw, upgrade a random upgradable card in your hand for this combat. Permanent deck upgrades are not changed.
relicRule.OrangePellets: Play an Attack, Skill and Power in one turn to remove your debuffs. Can trigger again after another trio.
relicRule.Ectoplasm: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Future Gold gain is prevented. Already-owned Gold remains available for purchases and removal.
relicRule.TinyHouse: On pickup: gain 5 Max HP, 50 Gold, a potion and a card reward; upgrade one random upgradable card.
relicRule.RunicCube: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card per HP-loss event. Enemy hits that reach HP and self-inflicted HP loss both trigger it. Each event with positive actual HP loss draws once; fully blocked or prevented HP loss supplies zero draws.
relicRule.RunicDome: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Enemy intents are hidden.
relicRule.VelvetChoker: Gain 1 Energy each turn. You may play at most 6 cards per turn.
relicRule.CursedKey: Gain 1 Energy each turn in all combats. Opening a non-boss chest adds a random Curse immediately, even if you skip its rewards. You can leave a chest unopened: this gives no chest rewards and adds no Curse. Boss relic chests do not add a Curse.
relicRule.BlackStar: Elite combat rewards include one additional relic.
relicRule.BustedCrown: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Card rewards offer 2 fewer cards; this does not reduce shop or {{entity_card_Discovery}} choices.
relicRule.QuestionCard: Card rewards generated after obtaining this relic offer 1 additional card, including colorless card rewards. Already-generated reward offers keep their existing cards. Shop inventory and combat {{entity_card_Discovery}} choices keep their own choice counts.
relicRule.CallingBell: On pickup: add the unremovable {{entity_card_CurseOfTheBell}} and receive one random Common, Uncommon and Rare relic.
relicRule.CoffeeDripper: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Cannot choose Rest at campfires; other healing still works.
relicRule.EmptyCage: On pickup: choose 2 removable cards to remove from your deck. If at most 2 are removable, remove them automatically.
relicRule.FusionHammer: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Cannot choose Smith at campfires; upgrades from cards, events and other sources still work.
relicRule.PandorasBox: On pickup: replace every starter Strike and Defend, including upgraded copies, with random cards from your character's Common, Uncommon and Rare pools. Replacements are not chosen by the player; Egg relics can upgrade them.
relicRule.PhilosopherStone: Gain 1 Energy each turn. All enemies start combat with 1 additional Strength.
relicRule.RunicPyramid: Do not perform the ordinary end-of-turn hand discard. This does not grant Retain: Ethereal cards still exhaust, and other discard effects still work. The hand limit still applies.
relicRule.SacredBark: Double potion potency. Fixed effects without a scalable potency, such as choosing among 3 discovered cards, are not doubled.
relicRule.SlaversCollar: Gain 1 additional Energy each turn during elite and boss combats. Ordinary combats do not receive this energy.
relicRule.SneckoEye: Draw 2 additional cards each turn. Start combat with Confusion: each draw can randomize a card's nonnegative combat cost to 0-3. Negative costs (including X-cost and negative unplayable costs) are excluded.
relicRule.Sozu: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Cannot obtain new potions; potions already held can still be used.
relicRule.BlackBlood: Replaces {{entity_relic_BurningBlood}}. At the end of each victorious combat, heal 12 HP instead of {{entity_relic_BurningBlood}}'s 6.
relicRule.MarkOfPain: Gain 1 Energy each turn. At combat start, shuffle 2 {{entity_card_Wound}}s into your draw pile.
relicRule.BurningBlood: At the end of each victorious combat, heal 6 HP.
relicRule.Pear: On pickup: gain 10 Max HP and heal 10 HP, subject to healing restrictions.
relicRule.HappyFlower: Every 3 player turns, gain 1 Energy. The turn counter carries between combats.
relicRule.Sundial: Every 3 draw-pile shuffles, gain 2 Energy. The shuffle counter carries between combats.
relicRule.Abacus: Whenever your discard pile is shuffled into your draw pile, gain 6 Block. Can trigger multiple times in a turn. This relic does not itself cause a shuffle; reaching an empty draw pile while drawing can cause one.
relicRule.Calipers: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block instead of all Block, keeping any positive remainder. Enemy attacks and other Block expenditures still consume it. If {{entity_power_Barricade}} is active, it preserves all remaining Block and Calipers does not remove 15.
relicRule.CaptainsWheel: At the start of turn 3 of each combat, gain 18 Block.
relicRule.DollysMirror: On pickup: choose a card in your deck and add a duplicate with the same upgrade level.
relicRule.Shuriken: Every 3 Attack cards played in a single turn, gain 1 Strength for the rest of combat. The attack counter resets each turn; multiple groups of 3 can trigger.
relicRule.Kunai: Every 3 Attack cards played in a single turn, gain 1 Dexterity for the rest of combat. Counts cards, not damage hits or targets. The attack counter resets each turn; gained Dexterity does not. Multiple groups of 3 can trigger in one turn. Dexterity increases card-generated Block, not potion Block or retaliation damage.
relicRule.OddMushroom: While you are Vulnerable, incoming Attack damage is multiplied by 1.25 instead of 1.5 before rounding and Block. Does not prevent or remove Vulnerable, change its duration, or weaken your attacks against Vulnerable enemies.
relicRule.MutagenicStrength: At combat start, gain 3 Strength and an equal Lose Strength debuff that removes 3 Strength at the end of your first turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
relicRule.Orichalcum: At the end of your turn, check your current Block before end-of-turn Power gains such as {{entity_power_Metallicize}}. If it is 0, gain 6 Block. {{entity_power_Metallicize}} then adds its own Block, so the two effects stack when this check starts at 0 Block. Having any Block at the check prevents only Orichalcum's gain.
relicRule.Vajra: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength for the rest of that combat.
relicRule.JuzuBracelet: A normal Monster room rolled for a question-mark map node becomes an Event instead. Does not prevent fixed combats within events or fights at Monster, Elite and Boss map nodes.
relicRule.BronzeScales: At the start of each combat, gain 3 Thorns. Whenever an enemy attacks you, deal 3 damage back per hit, even when its damage is blocked.
relicRule.PenNib: Every tenth Attack card you play deals double damage, including each hit and enemy target of that card. Counts Attack cards, not individual hits. The counter carries between combats; at counter 9 the next Attack is doubled.
relicRule.Nunchaku: Every tenth Attack card played grants 1 Energy and resets the counter to 0. Counts Attack cards, not individual hits. The counter carries between turns and combats; at counter 9 the next Attack grants the Energy.
relicRule.CeramicFish: Whenever a card is added to your master deck, gain 9 Gold. Cards generated only for the current combat do not qualify.
relicRule.PaperFrog: Your attacks against Vulnerable enemies deal 75% additional damage instead of the normal 50%.
