deck.statusDiscardRoute: create in Discard -> reshuffle -> Draw -> draw into Hand
deck.statusDrawRoute: create in Draw -> draw into Hand
deck.statusPersistent: After drawing, ordinary end-turn discard permits later reshuffles and draws.
deck.statusEthereal: After drawing, Ethereal exhausts it if it remains in Hand at turn end under the supplied Retain rules. Discarding it earlier permits a later reshuffle and draw.
deck.statusRouteMissing: Status route needs its typed destination and persistence.
deck.statusRoute: {{card}}: {{count}} {{card2}}; {{entry}}. {{later}} Draw-triggered effects apply at draw into Hand. Exhausting the Status cuts this ordinary redraw route; Retain or a skipped hand discard keeps it in Hand until a later pile-changing effect.
deck.strikeCountRule: N counts Strike-tagged copies across Hand, Draw and Discard together, including the played copy exactly once. Each counted copy entering Exhaust lowers N by one; a counted copy returning to those piles raises N by one.
deck.retainedProtection: other owned fixed on-play Block or persistent enemy Strength reduction groups
deck.battleTranceFirst: Use other needed on-play or Exhaust-triggered draws before BattleTrance.
deck.battleTranceNoDraw: Draws requested afterward during that same turn face NoDraw, so compare that order with the useful actions the new draw reaches.
deck.battleTranceSources: Owned draw sources affected by this order: {{sources}}.
deck.drawCoverage: Reviewed on-play multi-draw inventory: {{copies}} of {{size}} original cards ({{owned}});
deck.fixedBlockAccess: original cards requesting at least {{block}} Block on play
deck.reductionAccess: original cards requesting persistent enemy Strength reduction
deck.attackAccess: original Attack-type cards, each with its supplied output and conditions
deck.multiDrawAccess: original on-play multi-draw cards, with their own payment and selection rules
deck.inventorySourceMismatch: Deck comparison requires mechanics bound to the current public inventory.
deck.inventoryAttributesMismatch: Deck comparison mechanics differ from the current owned card attributes.
deck.inventoryMechanicsMissing: Deck comparison lacks matching instance mechanics.
deck.compareExhaustEngine: Compare this deployed access engine's additional draws from {{list}} with the owned {{multiDrawCopies}} on-play multi-draw copies ({{list2}}). Each route uses its own access, fuel, payment and lifecycle.
deck.preferExhaustEngine: Prioritize this access engine over another ordinary paid attack or skipping in this owned plan: {{list}} supply reusable Exhaust routes, while owned reviewed on-play draws provide at most self-replacement.
deck.exhaustEngineSetup: Deploying this Power enables those routes to reach existing useful cards. Compare deployment protection and the listed Energy sources as its realization conditions.
deck.bowlOutcomeMissing: Singing Bowl needs its matching native immediate resource outcome.
deck.priorityWholeDeck: Compare additions with the current whole deck and keeping this draw slot. Taking a card retains every original copy; removing a weak recurring draw changes the original pool.
deck.priorityAttack: For an additional attack, compare the useful output payable within the owned Energy and attack pool with access to existing output and protection. Its damage above one Strike describes the card; its recommendation depends on the whole-deck increment.
deck.priorityAccessEngine: An access engine gains value from its listed owned triggers and payment sources. Compare its deployment cost with reaching and paying useful actions after deployment. Protection can buy that deployment time.
deck.priorityAdditionalCopy: For another copy of an owned function, compare its actual additional quantity, earlier access and combined applications. A recurring Exhaust effect can supply triggers on later uses after ordinary redraws; engine deployment is paid before those triggers.
deck.priorityProtection: Additional protection earns value through another payable protective draw and, for persistent reduction, extra successful applications. Compare that quantity and access gain with its draw slot and Energy cost. Single-card Block/Energy efficiency compares those cards when reached; whole-deck coverage depends on their copy counts and access as well.
deck.prioritySetupProtection: Engine deployment protection uses the combined Energy and access of the engine and protective action. Later attack turns need their own protection. Independent draw, retained protection and deployed passive effects can cover those needs under their supplied triggers; already abundant usable coverage favors preserving access to the engine.
deck.normalUnplayable: Its supplied normal-play rule is unplayable
deck.normalXCost: Its normal X-cost play uses the Energy available at use
deck.deployedLifecycle: leaves ordinary card circulation after deployment
deck.removalMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: remove one permanent copy; deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}. {{payment}}; instance base damage {{damage}}, Block {{block}}; {{lifecycle}}. Its full supplied effects define the function forgone.
deck.removalRetainedAccess: Removing a weak recurring draw improves access to retained setup, useful damage and protection in upcoming fights. Compare its draw burden with the owned alternatives and their payment.
deck.removalForegoneFunction: Preserve a target whose damage, protection, access or enabling function remains useful in the owned plan. Its lifecycle determines how long its draw burden persists during combat.
deck.removalGoldOpportunity: Compare this removal with current useful purchases and retaining Gold for a connected later shop. Leaving keeps the target through intervening fights and gives up this shop's removal opportunity; the next price increase follows an actual removal purchase.
deck.removalPreparationOpportunity: Compare this cleanup with the useful upgrade, recovery or other preparation available at this node. Keeping the target preserves its function and draw burden through the next fights.
deck.reviewTargetBudget: A specific target-function or budget fact needs maintainer review.
deck.skipMechanics: Skipping keeps the {{size}}-card original pool and the same Gold. Each offered addition retains those originals and adds one permanent copy; its play follows the supplied access, payment and lifecycle rules.
deck.competingAdditions: Actual competing additions: {{additions}}. Use the strongest relevant addition as the comparison, with its recorded benefit and realization conditions.
deck.keepVersusAddition: Compared with {{command}}, favor preserving access to owned useful cards when that addition's useful increment is outweighed by its extra draw and payment burden.
deck.gainVersusSkip: Compared with {{command}}, assess the useful function or output forgone by skipping when that addition improves the current preparation plan enough to justify its extra draw and payment.
deck.reviewAdditionPlan: A specific missing fact about an offered addition or the owned plan needs maintainer review for this comparison.
deck.battleTranceMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; costs {{cost}} Energy; while draw is allowed, requests {{requested}} cards before applying NoDraw for the rest of that turn. Spending this card and drawing contributes {{handChange}} to Hand before other effects and capacity.
deck.battleTranceTurnBoundary: Normal turn-start draw and deployed Brutality turn-start draw resolve before the player can play BattleTrance. Its NoDraw is removed at that turn's end; the next turn starts with ordinary drawing again.
deck.drawAndExhaustSources: Owned on-play draw: {{onPlayDraw}}. Owned per-Exhaust draw after deployment: {{exhaustDraw}}.
deck.battleTranceAccess: Assess additional access to owned payable output, protection and enabling cards during this turn. The net Hand gain costs the printed Energy and one original draw slot.
deck.battleTranceDrawCost: Compare keeping access to already sufficient owned draw and useful actions with this extra copy when the additional Hand access mainly reaches unusable or redundant actions.
deck.reviewAccessPayment: A specific missing access or payment fact needs maintainer review for this comparison.
deck.drawAdditionMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; costs {{cost}} Energy; on-play draw request {{requested}}; Hand contribution {{handChange}} before other effects and capacity.
deck.drawLifecycle: Played copy: {{exhausts}} before other deployed effects. Hand selection and pile-changing effects follow this candidate's supplied full rule.
deck.independentAccess: Assess earlier and repeated access to owned output, protection and enabling cards. Compare the added multi-draw or Hand turnover, its copy access and usable payment with another component that needs those cards.
deck.selectionTurnover: Use the supplied selection rule to exchange a current Hand card for fresh draws. Compare sacrificing a low-value or obstructive card, the newly reachable plays and later circulation.
deck.accessCosts: Weigh useful access against this copy's draw slot, Energy, Gold, HP and other printed costs, including the protection or recovery needed on the connected route.
deck.reviewDrawSelectionPayment: A specific missing draw, selection or payment fact needs maintainer review.
deck.conditionalRedraw: ordinary redraw permits later paid uses under its target condition
deck.strengthOutput: Assess the added Strength through the owned attacks ({{attackCopies}}) reached and paid after the gain, with each attack's supplied hit, target and Strength rules.
deck.additionalStrength: An additional source can reach Hand earlier and supply another successful gain. Compare that increment with the owned source amounts, copy access, deployment or redraw conditions, and timely attack access.
deck.strengthCost: Weigh the additional source's draw slot, acquisition cost and play payment against accessing and protecting the already-owned useful actions.
deck.reviewSourceAttackTiming: A specific source, attack or timing fact needs maintainer review.
deck.blockAttackMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; costs {{cost}} Energy. Current Block at attack resolution supplies base damage. {{card2}}Strength, Weak, Vulnerable, target, relic modifiers and other effects follow the full supplied Attack rule.
deck.sameHandBlockPayment: Same-Hand payment: {{card}} -> {{card2}}; {{cost}} of {{baseEnergy}} base Energy; Block request {{block}} before modifiers. Access to both cards and other needed actions determines usable output.
deck.ownedRetention: Owned retention: {{retention}}. Cross-turn output uses Block remaining after the intervening enemy actions and the supplied retention rules.
deck.ownedMultiplication: Owned multiplication: {{multiplication}}. Each multiplication uses the Block present when that card resolves, with access and payment for that use.
deck.ownedDamageCaps: Owned damage-cap protection: {{damageCaps}}. Apply its actual active duration to the enemy hits before evaluating surviving Block.
deck.damageCapSource: {{card}}: {{cost}} Energy, request {{amount}} Intangible with damage cap {{cap}}; {{exhausts}}
deck.sameTurnBlockOutput: Compare useful damage from owned payable Block generation followed by this attack in the same turn, together with the protection that Block supplies.
deck.retainedBlockOutput: Compare deploying {{retention}}, building surplus through enemy turns using owned Block sources ({{fixedPlayedBlock}}), then reaching and paying this attack. Owned multiplication ({{multiplication}}) and protection use their actual access and timing.
deck.blockOutputCost: Compare the extra damage conversion with improving access to the existing protection, growth and attacks. Rate the conversion using reachable Block and the payment for the whole sequence.
deck.reviewBlockTimingPayment: A specific Block, timing or payment fact needs maintainer review.
deck.attackAdditionMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; Attack copies {{typeBefore}}->{{typeAfter}}; retains the owned attack suite; {{cost}}; base Energy {{baseEnergy}}/turn.
deck.attackXCost: normal X-cost play uses available Energy at use
deck.baseHits: Base damage per hit {{baseDamagePerHit}}; hits per play {{count}}. Resolved Strength applies on each actual hit before the other attack modifiers.
deck.strikeDamageRequest: Damage request before Strength and other combat modifiers: {{base}} + {{perCard}} * N. {{countRule}}
deck.randomHits: Each hit chooses among current enemies. With one enemy, every hit goes to that enemy.
deck.attackDrawContribution: Its on-play draw requests {{requested}} cards; the supplied draw/topdeck rule contributes {{handChange}} to Hand before other effects and capacity.
deck.attackExhaustLifecycle: The printed card Exhausts after play; further uses follow owned recovery and lifecycle modifiers.
deck.ownedExhaustDrawPayoffs: Owned draw payoffs per Exhaust event after deployment: {{exhaustDraw}}.
deck.attackOutputAccess: Assess earlier access to useful payable damage against the whole owned attack suite. Weak early attacks or a concrete damage coverage gap can make another efficient attack valuable.
deck.attackExtraOutput: Assess the extra useful attack play and its damage beyond the attacks already payable in that turn or fight, including the named owned relic or Strength interaction and protection still needed.
deck.attackAddedFunction: Assess the supplied draw, retrieval, debuff, cleanup, resource or deployed Exhaust payoff as this addition's increment. Use its named owned sources and access/payment order together.
deck.attackDrawPaymentCost: Favor access to owned protection, draw and enabling cards when this addition mainly repeats damage already reachable and payable. Compare that draw and Energy burden with the extra useful output or function.
deck.reviewOutputAccessEncounter: A specific missing output, access, payment or encounter fact needs maintainer review for this comparison.
deck.protectionAdditionMechanics: {{card}}{{upgradeSuffix}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; normal play costs {{cost}} Energy; the new copy occupies an original draw slot.
deck.blockOnPlay: On play request {{blockRequest}} Block before combat modifiers.
deck.skillExhaustDeployment: {{card}}: {{cost}} Energy to deploy, then played Skills Exhaust
deck.blockSelfExhaustEnergy: First usable benefit: the normal paid play supplies {{blockRequest}} Block directly. Additional {{energy_gain_on_exhaust}} Energy triggers when this card itself enters Exhaust. Owned applicable Exhaust routes: {{exhaustPaths}}. Compare the direct Block and the additional triggered Energy separately.
deck.protectionDrawContribution: On play request {{requested}} draw; the supplied draw/topdeck rule contributes {{handChange}} to Hand before other effects and capacity.
deck.persistentReductionApplications: Each successful play requests {{amount}} Strength reduction on {{target}}. If all owned persistent-reduction originals and this copy apply to the same target, the requested total changes {{before}}->{{before2}} before intervening clears or Strength changes. Each amount affects subsequent attack hits while present. The played card's Exhaust controls its reuse; the applied reduction remains. Artifact and target effects use the supplied rules.
deck.protectiveDraw: An additional payable protective draw improves coverage when existing protective copies arrive sparsely. Compare its quantity and sample access with its Energy cost, setup protection and later attack turns; include its other supplied on-play effects.
deck.selfExhaustEnergy: The additional Energy uses a route exhausting this source card itself. Owned applicable Exhaust routes: {{exhaustPaths}}; its Ethereal flag is {{ethereal}}. Assess that trigger separately from the direct paid Block.
deck.extraReductionApplication: An additional successful application deepens mitigation on one target or covers another eligible target. Compare actual affected hits, copy access, Artifact and target Strength changes with spending another draw and its payment.
deck.protectionCoverageCost: Keeping this draw slot favors access to existing useful actions when usable protection is already abundant, independent access reaches it, or this extra payment competes with more useful setup and actions.
deck.reviewAccessPaymentEncounter: A specific missing access, payment or encounter fact needs maintainer review for this comparison.
deck.additionalHandSelection: additional Hand removal/selection uses the supplied rule
deck.onPlayHandContribution: Hand contribution {{handChange}}{{handChange2}} from spending this card and its draw/topdeck, before other Hand effects, capacity or draw prevention
deck.exhaustAttacksSummary: Attacks that Exhaust when played: {{playedExhaustAttacks}}. Their original copies supply one ordinary play before recovery effects.
deck.laterDrawSummary: Draw on later turns after Power deployment: {{laterTurnDraw}}.
deck.exhaustDrawSummary: Draw per Exhaust event after Power deployment: {{exhaustDraw}}.
deck.exhaustSourcesSummary: Owned Exhaust event sources: on-play {{playedExhaust}}; unplayed Ethereal at turn end {{ethereal}}; effects exhausting other cards {{otherCardExhaust}}. Printed reusable other-card Exhaust effects: {{reusableOtherCardExhaust}}; later uses need ordinary redraw and payment, with combat lifecycle modifiers applied.
deck.statusSummary: Owned Status generation and later routes: {{renderStatusRoutes}}.
deck.fixedBlockSummary: Reviewed fixed Block on play: {{fixedPlayedBlock}}. Compare mitigation, potions and recurring protection from their supplied rules as well.
deck.reductionSummary: Owned persistent enemy Strength reduction: {{persistentReduction}}. Target Strength changes, Artifact and debuff clears follow their supplied rules.
deck.exhaustReductionPersists: the played card Exhausts, the applied reduction remains
deck.inventorySamplingRule: Inventory access reference: uniform sampling without replacement from original permanent copies. Each percentage is the chance of at least one matching original in a sample of the stated size. Actual combat draw uses its relics, extra draws, generated cards and pile changes; play additionally requires payment and applicable effect conditions.
deck.additionSummary: {{command}}: deck {{sizeBefore}}->{{sizeAfter}}; {{type}} copies {{typeBefore}}->{{typeAfter}}; original copies retained; cost {{cost}}c.

deck.laterDrawIncrement: After deployment, request {{laterTurnDraw}} on later turns.
deck.exhaustDrawIncrement: After deployment, request {{drawPerExhaustAfterDeployment}} per Exhaust event; owned trigger sources are listed above.
deck.blockIncrement: On play request {{blockRequest}} Block, before combat modifiers.
deck.reductionIncrement: On play request {{amount}} Strength reduction on {{target}}; restoration {{restoration}}.
deck.reductionAdds: Each successful application subtracts its amount from the target's current Strength; successive applications on the same enemy add their reductions while present.
deck.reductionLifetime: The played card's Exhaust governs card reuse; the applied reduction remains until a target effect changes or clears it.
deck.reductionOtherEffects: Artifact, debuff clears and scheduled restoration use the supplied rules.
